strategy.summary: Near22 is a privacy-focused chat application designed to enable users to connect with people nearby without the need for logins or tracking. The project aims to launch a public iOS app and release an Android beta, while also exploring small business use cases. Funding from Kickstarter is intended to cover hosting costs and accelerate development efforts.

Kickstarter funding will help finalize the iOS App Store release and accelerate Android development.
